About Us

CasinoMY Insider is a Malaysian online casino review site. We test real-money casino platforms available to players in Malaysia — depositing our own ringgit, clearing the bonus, requesting a withdrawal and timing how long it takes — then publish the result whether it flatters the operator or not. Readers come to us as their casino insider Malaysia reference point: the place to check a licence number, a rollover figure or a payout claim before money changes hands. We are funded by affiliate commission, which never affects a rating.

CasinoMY Insider founded in 2025, we are a fully independent review portal dedicated to helping Malaysia players discover safe, fair, and rewarding online-casino sites. Our experts test every platform with real money, translate complicated terms into plain language, and update each guide the moment bonuses, banking limits, or regulations change.

Who We Are

CasinoMY Insider is an independent review hub created to help Malaysian players find safe, enjoyable, and fairly-tested casino sites. We do not own or operate any gambling platform; our sole focus is to give readers honest, data-driven insights they can trust.

Our Mission

Make every Malaysian player feel confident and well-informed before placing a single wager online.

Our Vision

Become the most-trusted, community-driven resource for online-casino knowledge in Southeast Asia—where transparent reviews, expert guidance, and responsible-gaming tools live in one place.

What We Do

  • Hands-on Testing – We open real-money accounts, deposit, play, withdraw, and record every step.
  • Local Relevance – All content is tailored to Malaysian payment methods, player preferences, and language nuances.
  • Continuous Updates – Each review is rechecked at least once a quarter—or whenever a casino changes bonuses, banking limits, or terms.
  • Player-First Guides – From e-wallet top-ups to bonus wagering calculators, our tutorials keep things practical and jargon-free.

How We Review (6-Step Protocol)

  1. Sign-Up & KYC – Measure verification hurdles and data security.
  2. Deposit Test – Time deposits via FPX, DuitNow, and crypto where available.
  3. Gameplay Audit – Spin 200+ RNG rounds and 10 live-dealer hands; check RTP certificates.
  4. Withdrawal Speed – Request two payouts on different days and log processing time.
  5. Support Stress-Test – Contact live chat, email, and phone with real queries.
  6. Responsible-Gaming Tools – Verify loss limits, self-exclusion, and reality checks.
